mode.fulfilment: Not a literal forecast: it would count as fulfilled only if a silent, uncut long-form reading series of this kind were actually made and found an audience, built by anyone.

mode.fulfilment: A Twenty-Dollar Loop trend circulates on platforms after and through the circulation of the document that describes it.
mode.basis_quote: Retrocausal canon formation — the document enables the trend it describes.
mode.note: The charter treats the document as the cause of the trend it documents (retrocausal screening, §II.B), so the anticipation acts on its present by being read and circulated.
